---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a capability
labels: enhancement
---

**Before you submit**

- [ ] I searched existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] I read the [ROADMAP](docs/ROADMAP.md) and [PARITY](docs/PARITY.md) docs

**Problem / user need**
A clear description of the problem or user need.

**Proposed solution**
A clear description of what you want to happen.

**Which shell** (Lightroom panel / Snapseed gesture / both) and **phase**
(see ROADMAP: P1/P2/P2.5/P3/P3.5/P4).

**FOSS/privacy constraints** (must stay local-first, no proprietary SDKs,
no paid services).

**Alternatives considered**
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Additional context**
Add any other context, screenshots, or references here.
